_comment: Who may run what. Read by app/rbac.py at startup and by POST /api/engine/refresh.
Semantics: a workflow is allowed when its id is listed OR its category is listed.
A role that is absent from this file gets nothing; admin cannot be restricted here.
Model folders use the same spelling as the rows in GET /api/models: bare names, so
The child list below is exactly what the child's 55 allowed workflows can touch, so a
workflow that gains a new model folder will visibly stop being complete for them.
Deleting or downloading a model and changing settings stay admin-only in the routes.
max_active_jobs can only tighten STUDIO_MAX_USER_ACTIVE_JOBS; max_jobs_per_day and
max_output_gb are separate household allowances: runs per UTC day (a rerun counts)
and the total size of the account's outputs. Both answer 429 until something is freed.
